top.summary: Rosen Law Firm reminds investors in Aardvark Therapeutics who purchased securities during the IPO on February 13, 2025 through May 14, 2026 of an October 13, 2026 deadline to nominate a lead plaintiff. top.title: URGENT AARDVARK DEADLINE: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. Urges Aardvark Therapeutics, Inc. Investors to Contact the Firm Seeking Lead Plaintiff Role Before October 13th
top.summary: A class action lawsuit has been filed against Aardvark Therapeutics in the U.S. District Court for the Southern District of California. The lawsuit alleges that defendants made materially false and misleading statements in the company's IPO registration statement and throughout the class period (February 13, 2025 to May 14, 2026), specifically regarding the safety and commercial prospects of their drug ARD-101. Investors who purchased shares during this period can apply to be lead plaintiff by October 13, 2026.

top.title: AARD 4-DAY DEADLINE ALERT: Aardvark Therapeutics Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead Shareholder Class Action Lawsuit Before October 13, 2026 Lead Plaintiff Deadline - HBSS
top.summary: Hagens Berman announces a securities class action lawsuit against Aardvark Therapeutics for allegedly making materially false statements about ARD-101's safety. The company failed to disclose cardiac observations during trials, leading to a voluntary pause of the Phase 3 HERO trial in February 2026 (56% stock decline) and an FDA clinical hold in May 2026 (32.1% additional decline). Investors with substantial losses have until October 13, 2026, to become lead plaintiffs.

A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

Patient dosing is planned for 2026 with initial safety data expected in Q1 2027.

top.summary: Arcutis Biotherapeutics presented clinical data for ZORYVE (roflumilast) across multiple inflammatory skin conditions at major dermatology conferences. The INTEGUMENT-INFANT trial showed the drug was well-tolerated in infants aged 3-24 months with atopic dermatitis, with 34.4% achieving disease clearance at 4 weeks. Additional analyses demonstrated ZORYVE's efficacy in treating psoriasis on special sites including the scalp and genitals, with improvements in sexual function and quality of life. Real-world research highlighted concerns about long-term topical corticosteroid use, including skin thinning and systemic side effects, positioning ZORYVE as a potential alternative therapy.

top.title: Acoramidis Associated with Significantly Improved Clinical Outcomes Versus Tafamidis in ATTR-CM in an Independent, Real-World Study of U.S. Electronic Health Records
top.summary: An independent real-world study of 2,684 ATTR-CM patients from U.S. electronic health records found that acoramidis was associated with an 18% lower risk of death, hospitalization, atrial fibrillation, and diuretic intensification compared to tafamidis. Acoramidis showed 27% lower risk of cardiovascular and heart failure hospitalizations. These findings replicate earlier comparative effectiveness analyses and support acoramidis as a preferred stabilizer treatment option.

top.title: Encaleret Increased Bone Turnover and Improved Participant-Reported Symptoms in the Phase 3 CALIBRATE Trial in ADH1
top.summary: BridgeBio announced positive Phase 3 CALIBRATE trial results for encaleret in autosomal dominant hypocalcemia type 1 (ADH1), showing 91% of participants achieved normal PTH levels compared to 0% on standard care, with 100% reporting symptom improvements versus 46% on conventional therapy. The FDA accepted the NDA with Priority Review (PDUFA date May 8, 2027), and the company initiated the Phase 3 RECLAIM-HP trial for chronic hypoparathyroidism.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

Investors have until December 7, 2026 to move the court if they wish to serve as lead plaintiff.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral

reasons.en: calls modestly richer than puts (+0.8 vol pts vs peers) — mild bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨略贵于看跌（+0.8 个波动点（相对同业））— 温和偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Rosen Law Firm announces a securities class action lawsuit against Innventure, Inc. (NASDAQ: INV) for allegedly making materially false and misleading statements regarding Accelsius Holdings LLC's transformative deal with DarkNX. The lawsuit claims defendants overstated revenue and cash flow targets for 2026 when no evidence existed that DarkNX was constructing or facilitating a large-scale AI data center. Investors who purchased securities between November 17, 2025 and August 13, 2026 may be eligible for compensation. The lead plaintiff deadline is October 27, 2026.

top.title: INV INVESTOR ALERT: Innventure, Inc. Investors with Substantial Losses Have Opportunity to Lead the INNVENTURE Securities Fraud Class Action - HBSS
top.summary: Innventure, Inc. (NASDAQ: INV) faces a securities class action lawsuit after its stock price crashed 55% on August 14, 2026, following the company's removal of the DarkNX project from its 2026 forecast and suspension of revenue guidance. Forensic research firm Morpheus Research published a report claiming the 300MW data center project with DarkNX was non-existent, with former executives allegedly using 'false information' and 'pure fiction' for revenue projections. The company later confirmed the deployment site was no longer available, leading to a 74% stock decline between May 27 and August 14, 2026.

top.title: PEP Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Margin Pressure and Growth Plans
top.summary: PepsiCo reduced its 2026 core EPS growth guidance to 2.5%-3.5% from 5%-7% due to rising input costs, weaker margins, and unfavorable product mix. top.title: Roche presents new Phase III one-year data for vamikibart in uveitic macular edema (UME), a serious cause of vision loss
top.summary: Roche announced one-year Phase III data from MEERKAT and SANDCAT studies showing vamikibart, an anti-IL-6 monoclonal antibody, demonstrated sustained vision improvements and macular thickness reductions in uveitic macular edema patients. The FDA has accepted Roche's Biologics License Application with an approval decision expected by July 2027. If approved, vamikibart would be the first non-steroid targeted treatment for UME, potentially establishing a new standard of care.

top.title: Roche Gets FDA Approval for Another Label Expansion of Tecentriq
top.summary: Roche received FDA approval for Tecentriq in combination with chemotherapy for adjuvant treatment of stage III deficient DNA mismatch repair (dMMR) colon cancer. The phase III ATOMIC study demonstrated a 50% reduction in recurrence or death risk, with 86% disease-free survival at 36 months versus 76% for chemotherapy alone. This marks Tecentriq's 12th U.S. indication and positions it as the first approved adjuvant immunotherapy for this cancer type.

top.title: Next Generation Antibody Therapeutics Market, 2nd Edition: Global Industry Trends and Forecast to 2035 | Immunocytokines and Combination Therapies Drive Growth
top.summary: The global next generation antibody therapeutics market is projected to grow from USD 5.45 billion to USD 5.76 billion by 2035, with a modest 1% CAGR. Growth is driven by advances in biotechnology, targeted treatments, and expanding clinical pipelines for cancer, rare diseases, and cardiovascular conditions. Immunocytokines and combination therapies are expected to demonstrate the strongest growth potential, while North America is projected to maintain approximately 64% market share.

Micron Technology leads with 32.6% expected long-term earnings growth, followed by Banco Bilbao at 15.7%. All five stocks meet screening criteria for cash flow above $1B, superior ROE, and attractive valuations.

top.title: Bet on These Defense ETFs Amid Escalating Yemen War
top.summary: Escalating Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia are expected to increase demand for air-defense systems, missiles, and radar technology. Following a $142 billion U.S. defense agreement and a $2 billion package approved in July 2026, major defense contractors are positioned to benefit from increased orders. Defense-focused ETFs offer diversified exposure to these contractors without single-stock risk.

top.title: GE Aerospace Down 15% in 3 Months: Is This a Buying Opportunity?
top.summary: GE Aerospace shares have declined 15% in three months, but strong commercial engine demand, robust Q2 2026 revenue growth of 27%, and raised free cash flow guidance to $8.9-$9.2 billion support a positive outlook. However, elevated valuation at 34.79X forward P/E (above industry average of 27.16X), rising debt levels of $19.2 billion, and surging costs present risks. The stock maintains a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy) rating despite trading below its 50-day and 200-day moving averages.

top.title: Can Lockheed Martin's Training Solutions Expand Its Defense Business?
top.summary: Lockheed Martin announced a Direct Commercial Sale contract with the Philippine Department of National Defense to provide S-70i Black Hawk simulators, maintenance training, and support through 2032. This marks the first order for LMT's S-70i Black Hawk training devices and represents the company's expansion into military training and simulation solutions. With 2026 and 2027 EPS estimates showing growth of 31.7% and 8.44% respectively, and trading at a valuation discount to industry peers, LMT holds a Zacks Rank #2 (Buy).

The law firm is offering free case evaluations to affected customers.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -4.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -4.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
